title: Multidisciplinary and Coordinated Follow-up Based on a Telemonitoring Web Platform for Improving CPAP Compliance in Low Cardiovascular Risk Sleep Apnea Patients : OPTISAS 1 Study

sections.abstract: Targeted population: Sleep apnea patients at low cardiovascular risk newly treated by CPAP Hypothesis: Six months CPAP compliance might be greater in the telemonitoring arm compared to usual CPAP care. Main goal: To compare 6-months CPAP compliance when Sleep Apnea patients at low cardiovascular risk are randomly allocated to usual CPAP care or a multidisciplinary and coordinated follow-up based on a telemonitoring web platform.
